content: Samson okhem anọng pa Philistiya
K'ogbe mẹ, m'ọphagbe kwa wit, wa Samson otzima ovu-nwa bi, ọtza odibh kwanọng kwẹ. Oben bi, “Kaam nchin k'ẹmaanggọ cha kwanọng kwaam.” Yina, wa otte kwa kwanọng kokher bi, ndim k'ẹtzaanga.
Iwa otte kwa kwanọng oben bi, “Kaam iwa nnong kẹ bi, ominanwa nwa kọ kọdaakhi, kẹ wọ osi, ndọkh-ẹ nnang oyokh-ẹkhaan wani kwọ. Ọgbaanọkka kw'ikhakhari k'ojibhi ọyọhng-ẹ o? Kọ tzọkha oyok nwuma.”
Iwa Samson oben bẹ bi, “Ogbe nwa, oponga-pyibha kindọkha k'odik kwa ńsi anọng pa Philistiya; Kaam ńsi bẹ itzama ọkhaam-ọkhaam.”
Mando kw'ofon ọtza ọbọkha azizi arọbh chi, ọtzọkha bẹ ọdabh afa-afa ka nsara. Ọn-ọtzọkha ikhebh ọdabh ka nsara mfa kpenamkpen.
Ọtzọkha okhebh mva oyeni, yina on-otte azizi mba ọbọhk k'iwoni s'awit s'anọng pa Philistiya. Ọkwọmi awit pa bẹ aye-oye ọmaana p'atzima abe k'iwoni, ọmaana iwoni sa grep ttara iwoni s'oliv.

K'ogbe kw'anọng pa Philistiya an-abọbhi bi, “Anyi wọ osi odik nwa?” Bẹ agbaak bẹ bi, “Samson kw'ode ọnyẹ kw'ojinọng kw'ofon Timnit wọ osi odik nwa e, okhuri da bẹ atzọk kwanọng kwẹ anang oyok-ẹkhaan kwẹ e.” Mando kw'anọng pa Philistiya afon atza akwọmi ominanwa nwa ọmaana otte maa, bẹ ape.
Samson oben bẹ bi, “Mada bọng an-asi manda, kaam nchekhi bi, ọwọhng kinkwokha maa ndukha odik kwa bọng asi.”
Wa otzima ittem-dọkhiji orima bẹ abẹ, ofhu bẹ k'ọhaabh. Obina ọtza owobha k'ọmma-kw'itzakpa kw'Etam.
Iwa anọng pa Philistiya atza abhing ka Juda, bẹ anyaami apyiri ka Lehi.
Wa anọng pa Juda an-abọbh bi, “Okhuri yan kwa bọng akwu arima man abẹ?” Bẹ abhina bi, “M'ọkk'ọkwa bi, okwu ọbọkha Samson ọtza ọkhe mgbakkọhbh e, mọsẹ-ẹ odik kw'osi man.”

Mẹ wọ ofon, anọng pa Juda nnọhna nzenamfa obhiri arọbh jobh, ahakha k'ọmma-kw'itzakpa kw'Etam atza aben Samson bi, “Ode bi kọ katzini bi, mowobh k'irekhirek kw'anọng pa Philistiya? Bọng odik kw'asi man ma o?” Obhina bi, “Kaam nginggẹ ndukha odik kwa bẹ asi-m e.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, bẹ aben-ẹ bi, “Mọkk'ọkwa bi, okwu ọdabh-ọ, mọtzọkh-ọ ọnang anọng pa Philistiya.” Samson oben bi, “Bọng chekhi anang-m bi, bọbọng ọkhaam arang afhu-m.”
Bẹ abhina bi, “Mokk'okhera. Man kọ kofhu, mokhinggẹ ọdabh-ọ, ọtzọkh-ọ ọnang bẹ.” Mando kwa bẹ atzim ndik mmasẹ mfa adabh-ẹ, atzima ayin k'itzakpa.

Mada opyiri ka Lehi, anọng pa Philistiya am-awuri amọng arenga atzor-ẹ. Mando kw'egwugwuma ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ẹhak ẹnwẹ-ẹ, ẹnang-ẹ ẹfa. Ndik sa bẹ adabh-ẹ ka mbọhk, ikpaara mach'adik-bukhi p'ekpon ẹkwọmi, ichaar-ẹ ka mbọhk.
Mando kw'odungi ọkhọbhi kw'agba p'ẹnyanyaang kw'ore mẹ, ọtzim-ẹ ofhu anọng nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh.
Mẹ wọ ofon, Samson oben bi,

content.text: ndima nsi bẹ ade macha nnyanyaang.
ndima mfhu ajinọng nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh.”

content: Mada okyer atzim mba ọgbagbaak, ọbhari ọkhọbhi nwa kw'agba p'ẹnyanyaang; wa bẹ ayeri ibe nna Ramat-Lehi.

Iwa ofon da asi akk'ẹ adaakha kpọng, obhom oyeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “Kọ akk'kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ekhema ch'ideden ananga. Ma, kaam nna nnenga isi-dadaakha abẹ, nda mpe ka mbọhk anọng p'ani ọkpakkọrikkọ asi o?”

Wa Ibinọkpaabyi osi asi amaam ayin k'ọmma k'eje ch'okwung k'irerek sa Lehi. Mada Samson ogwo asi mba, ẹfa ewobh-ẹ obiro ogwengi. Mẹ wọ ofon, bẹ ayeri okhekhaho nwa Ẹn-Hakore, kw'ọtzim owobh ka Lehi maa, apyiri ma.
Iwa Samson ode osi-aponga k'Israẹl ka cho ẹrọbh, k'ogbe kw'iwa anọng pa Philistiya adabhi bẹ.
